description: AI legal platform for law firms, trains on firm's own case data. Proprietary models fine-tuned on legal datasets. Enterprise contracts with BigLaw firms.
AI-powered answer engine with real-time search. Ad-supported free tier and Pro subscription ($20/mo). Competes with Google search and ChatGPT.
Open-source framework for building LLM applications. Developer tools and orchestration layer. Revenue from LangSmith platform (usage-based).
ChatGPT wrapper with custom UI, no proprietary model or data. Thin layer over OpenAI API. No data flywheel or defensible moat.
